responsibility: Lists the Arm cryptographic builtins in a compact macro table used by the backend builtin machinery. It enumerates the AES, SHA1, SHA256, and polynomial multiply operations together with their mnemonic names and operand/result vector modes, so other generated tables and builtin-registration code can derive declarations and expansion metadata from one authoritative description.
same_name_distinction: Is the compact builtin-description table for Arm crypto operations, enumerating names and operand/result modes for use by other machinery, whereas crypto.md contains the actual RTL expanders and instruction patterns for those operations.
